definitions.explanation: Groups of young people who ride motorcycles or cars in a reckless and noisy manner, often violating traffic laws. They are known for modified vehicles, loud exhaust pipes, and group rides through city streets, especially at night.

examples.japanese: {暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさい→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧。
⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っていた→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: A motorcycle gang was riding around in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}{暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: He was in a motorcycle gang when he was young, but now he works seriously.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{暴走|ぼうそう}→暴走：09481_bousou⟧ (reckless driving) and {族|ぞく} (tribe, group). Refers to youth subculture groups that emerged in Japan in the 1950s and peaked in the 1970s-80s. Members are typically young men who modify motorcycles and cars for loud exhaust and flashy appearance, riding in large groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧: crackdown on motorcycle gangs
- {暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join a motorcycle gang
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧{暴走族|ぼうそうぞく}: former motorcycle gang member

CULTURAL NOTE:
Their numbers have greatly declined since the 1980s peak. The {道路交通法|どうろこうつうほう} (Road Traffic Act) has been amended multiple times to crack down on group reckless driving. Some former members go on to become legitimate businesspeople, a path sometimes romanticized in manga and film. The related term {旧車會|きゅうしゃかい} refers to older enthusiasts who maintain the style but tend to be less confrontational.
